result.finding: Minimal security implementation: basic file upload validation only. No HTTPS, authentication, authorization, encryption, or security headers configured.
evidence: No SSL/TLS configuration in application.properties (no server.ssl.*)
No JWT, OAuth2, or authentication mechanism found in source code
No CORS, CSP, or HSTS headers configured
File upload validation: MIME type whitelist (image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp) and 10MB max size limit via application.properties
Spring Boot Validation (javax.validation) used for model-level constraints (@NotBlank, @Size, @Positive)
Database credentials stored in plaintext environment variables (not encrypted)
values: HTTPS/TLS: NOT configured (HTTP only on port 8080)
Encryption: NONE (data at rest and in transit unencrypted)
Input validation: file type and size validation on upload
Security risk: credentials hardcoded in docker-compose.yml environment variables
